claims.statement: Tom Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street was called the Champions' Retreat, where Mark Tuohy was engaged as a song-and-dance performer and sparrer.
claims.excerpt: He is engaged at Tom  Alilen’s ‘*‘Champions’ Retreat,’’ at 619 Market street.

claims.statement: William Reed, who accepted Mark Tuohy's challenge at the Champions' Retreat, broke a window and cut Tuohy's head with a piece of the glass.
claims.excerpt: He broke a window and taking a large piece of the glass cut Tuohy pretty badly about the head.

notes: Allen is named only as the owner of the Champions' Retreat; the incident happened at his saloon but he is not in it.
